info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Meionite Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Meionite Battery Detail Management API facilitates the creation of detailed entries for Meionite batteries within the catalog. This endpoint allows businesses to effectively manage product specifications, enhancing their inventory with detailed technical attributes. Ideal for manufacturers and retailers, this API streamlines the process of adding new battery details, ensuring accurate information is readily available for sales and marketing efforts. By utilizing this API, users can ensure their product catalog remains up-to-date and comprehensive.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for Meionite batteries. It accepts the necessary parameters in the request body, ensuring that the details are accurately recorded for future reference.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send the details for the Meionite battery. Ensure that all required fields are populated according to the schema to process the request successfully.
